title.en: Writing My Thoughts on a Night Journey

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本）。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 770.

note.en: Du Fu wrote it in 765, travelling down the Yangtze after leaving Chengdu. The second couplet is one of the great pictures in Chinese poetry, stars pressing down on a plain and moonlight heaving on the river; then he turns the same scale on himself and finds one gull. He doubted his writing would make his name. It did.
note.zh: 765 年杜甫离开成都、沿长江东下时所作。“星垂平野阔，月涌大江流”是中国诗里最壮阔的画面之一；接着他用同样的尺度看自己，只看见一只沙鸥。他怀疑自己会因文章而留名。他确实因此留了名。

excerpt.orig: 星垂平野闊，月湧大江流。
excerpt.en: Stars hang low over the wide plain; / the moon surges in the great river's flow.
excerpt.zh: 星垂平野阔，月涌大江流。
